components.name: Brutal Primary Button
components.description: Source-faithful primary action with square shape, black border, and hard offset shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-brutal-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; gap: 5.5px; border: 2px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 0; background: var(--primary-400); color: #000; font-family: var(--heading-font); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--line-strong); transition: transform 100ms, box-shadow 100ms; } .ds-btn-brutal-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--line-strong); } .ds-btn-brutal-primary:active { transform: translate(1px, 1px); box-shadow: 1px 1px 0 var(--line-strong); } .ds-btn-brutal-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--line-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Elegant Primary Button
components.description: Refined primary action that keeps Source Yellow but softens the treatment with radius and inset light.
components.css: .ds-btn-elegant-primary { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 6.75px 12px; gap: 5.5px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--primary-400); color: var(--primary-950); font-family: var(--sans-font); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0.5px oklch(1 0 0 / 0.15), 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.83 0.14 91.89 / 0.83); transition: transform 100ms, background 100ms, box-shadow 100ms; } .ds-btn-elegant-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.86 0.15 91.89); } .ds-btn-elegant-primary:active { transform: scale(0.985); } .ds-btn-elegant-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--primary-400); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Elegant Default Button
components.description: The high-contrast Elegant default action, anchored by ink rather than a saturated accent.
components.css: .ds-btn-elegant-default { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 6.75px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--foreground-strong); color: var(--foreground-inverse); font-family: var(--sans-font); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0.5px oklch(1 0 0 / 0.12), 0 0 0 1px var(--foreground-strong); transition: transform 100ms, background 100ms; } .ds-btn-elegant-default:hover { background: oklch(0.31 0.006 285); } .ds-btn-elegant-default:active { transform: scale(0.985); } .ds-btn-elegant-default:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--foreground-strong); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Brutal Input
components.description: Square field with source-faithful border and tactile focus shadow.
components.css: .ds-input-brutal { width: 100%; padding: 8px 12px; border: 2px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 0; background: var(--layer-panel); color: var(--foreground-strong); font-family: var(--heading-font); font-size: 14px; box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--line-strong); outline: none; } .ds-input-brutal:focus { box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--line-strong); } .ds-input-brutal[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: var(--state-danger-base); background: oklch(0.968 0.014 22.88 / 0.5); box-shadow: none; outline: 2px solid oklch(0.711 0.168 28.04 / 0.6); }

components.name: Elegant Input
components.description: Quiet field with hairline border, subtle hover lift, and precise invalid ring.
components.css: .ds-input-elegant { width: 100%; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.94 0 0); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--layer-field); color: oklch(0.205 0 0); font-family: var(--sans-font); font-size: 14px; outline: none; transition: border-color 200ms ease-out, box-shadow 200ms ease-out; } .ds-input-elegant::placeholder { color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--foreground-placeholder) 70%, transparent); } .ds-input-elegant:hover { border-color: oklch(0.91 0 0); box-shadow: oklch(0.159 0.016 266.594 / 0.03) 0 1px 2px; } .ds-input-elegant:focus-visible { border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--line-strong) 25%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklab, var(--line-strong) 8%, transparent); } .ds-input-elegant[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--state-danger-base) 45%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--state-danger-base) 12%, transparent); }

components.name: Elegant Badge
components.description: Full-pill metadata chip for quiet statuses and compact labels.
components.css: .ds-badge-elegant { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; width: fit-content; max-width: 100%; min-height: 20px; padding: 2px 10px; gap: 6px; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--layer-muted); color: var(--foreground-strong); font-family: var(--sans-font); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.22px; }

narrative.overview:
raft-ui turns an existing product language into a reusable component system without flattening its history. Brutal is the source-faithful register: square, high-contrast, tactile, and visibly descended from slock. Elegant is the product-grade register: quieter, more refined, and designed to shape future Raft APIs without abandoning the same semantic components.

Every component must support both themes through composition, slots, and tokenized recipes. The same Button, Dialog, Field, Badge, Separator, and overlay primitives should survive a theme switch without caller-side rewrites. The API belongs to Elegant's cleaner future, but the visual evidence of Brutal must remain first-class.

This system rejects public APIs shaped around one-off slock implementation details, local style overrides that should be theme tokens, monolithic components that block slot-level composition, decorative AI-flavored UI, marketing-page flourishes, oversized visual gestures, and expanding the main export surface before a component is ready.
keyCharacteristics: Dense, product-grade controls over decorative spectacle.

rules.name: The Dual-Register Rule
rules.body: A color token must mean the same semantic thing in both themes even when its visual treatment changes.

rules.name: The Yellow Rarity Rule
rules.body: Source Yellow is the primary action and brand signal. Do not use it as page wash, large decoration, or background atmosphere.

rules.name: The State-Is-Meaning Rule
rules.body: Cyan, lime, warning, and danger are reserved for information, success, warning, and destructive states. Never use them just to make a surface louder.

rules.name: The Interface Type Rule
rules.body: Type exists to make controls scannable. Do not introduce display-scale typography inside compact panels, cards, dialogs, or tool surfaces.

rules.name: The Register Integrity Rule
rules.body: Brutal may be bold and square; Elegant must be restrained and antialiased. Do not mix Brutal uppercase force into Elegant unless the component explicitly models a legacy semantic.

rules.name: The Structural-vs-Ambient Rule
rules.body: Brutal shadows move like blocks; Elegant shadows breathe like layers. Never give Brutal a soft blur or Elegant a comic-book offset.

rules.name: The State Pays for Depth Rule
rules.body: Extra depth must correspond to hover, focus, active, popover, modal, or dragged state. Static decoration is forbidden.

dos: Do build every component as composed parts and slots so callers can assemble real product structures without forking internals.
Do route colors, borders, shadows, typography, disabled states, and feedback states through theme tokens whenever possible.
Do design public APIs for Elegant's cleaner product direction while keeping Brutal faithful to slock semantics.
Do preserve visible focus states, keyboard behavior, accessible names, loading/disabled semantics, and aria-invalid-driven error styling.
Do keep unfinished or source-specific surfaces behind raft-ui/wip until their contracts are ready.
donts: Don't shape public APIs around one-off slock implementation details instead of reusable component semantics.
Don't make components that only work well in Elegant and leave Brutal as an afterthought.
Don't only preserve Brutal screenshots while breaking the newer Elegant direction.
Don't replace theme tokens with local style overrides when a tokenized solution is possible.
Don't build monolithic components that block slot-level composition.
Don't use decorative AI-flavored UI, marketing-page flourishes, or oversized visual gestures in product controls.
Don't expand the main export surface before a component is ready; unfinished work belongs behind raft-ui/wip.
